t: A low-power Bluetooth and Thread chip from Nordic for sensors and smart home gadgets.
steps: Buy a Seeed Studio XIAO nRF54L15 or the Sense version from Seeed Studio.
Get a USB-C cable that carries data.
Check the board revision on the Seeed wiki before wiring power pins.
Install the free Thonny editor on your computer.
Flash the Seeed MicroPython firmware with the steps in the Seeed wiki.
Run the blink example and watch the onboard light.
Move on to VS Code with the nRF Connect SDK for Bluetooth and Matter examples.
meta: Open Board. From $9.90. A few stores.
